keyLimits.en: Basic multi-regulation compliance features; priced on quote, no public rate
Adds compliance auditing and monitoring on top of Essential
Adds preference management, advanced customization and priority support

addOns.en: Advanced Compliance Monitoring, priced by scan volume and frequency
Preference Management Platform, priced by user database size and API calls
Server-Side Tagging is a separate product from the CMP: free up to 100k requests/month, pay-as-you-go tier up to 2M requests/month, custom Enterprise volume
Connected TV CMP, separate quote-based product

cautions.en: Every core CMP tier (Essential/Advanced/Premium) is quote-only; the only public numeric pricing is the Server-Side Tagging add-on's free and pay-as-you-go request tiers, which is a different product.

capabilities.en: Consent Management Platform (CMP) with multi-regulation compliance support (GDPR and others) and cross-domain/cross-device consent synchronization.
Customizable branded consent banners and preference center.
Native integrations with CRM/marketing tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Mailchimp and others) via the Preference Management Platform.
Automated compliance monitoring with scheduled scans and multi-scenario detection.

limitations.en: No public pricing for the core consent management product; every buyer must go through a sales quote.
Product is split into several separately priced modules (CMP, Advanced Compliance Monitoring, Preference Management, Server-Side Tagging, Connected TV CMP), adding procurement complexity.

reason.en: Direct CMP/consent-banner competitor targeting a similar European compliance market.

missingAlternatives.name: OneTrust
missingAlternatives.reason: Major enterprise consent/privacy management competitor, not linked as an alternative in the catalogue for Didomi.

missingAlternatives.name: Cookiebot
missingAlternatives.reason: Widely used CMP with public self-service pricing, useful as a budget contrast, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: No indicative price range was published for the Essential/Advanced/Premium CMP tiers; only sales quotes are available.
Currency for quotes was not stated on the page (USD assumed from site locale, not confirmed).
